body:
Founder reported sniper firing feeling doubled with 2 red frag indicators, first a false positive. Real root cause: hit_feedback (wire field driving apps/lobby's >=25 red double-ring kill marker) was never reset to 0 anywhere in physics.h's online multiplayer path -- a real kill's hit_feedback=30 stayed on the attacker's PlayerState and broadcast on every snapshot until their next hit, so the next shot always showed a stale kill ring first. Confirmed as a genuine gap by finding packages/simulation/local_game.h (the offline sim path) already has this exact decay pattern in two places -- physics.h's online path simply never got it. Fixed by adding the identical decay alongside attack_cooldown/is_shooting/ability_cooldown. Both apps/server and apps/lobby build clean, live server redeployed. Commit 1e7e90e.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-66: fixed false-positive red kill ring appearing before real kills
